storySubtitle: Every great love story has a beginning. Ours started with a chance encounter and grew into something extraordinary.

timeline.heading: First Glance
timeline.text: A rainy afternoon at a bookstore in San Francisco. Gio asked for directions; Augiela handed him the map. They talked for hours.

timeline.heading: Building a Life
timeline.text: Through quiet mornings and long adventures, they discovered that home wasn't a place — it was each other.

timeline.heading: The Proposal
timeline.text: At sunset on the cliffs of Big Sur, Gio got down on one knee. Augiela said yes before he could finish the question.

timeline.heading: Forever Begins
timeline.text: Surrounded by the people we love most, we begin the next chapter of our story — and we want you there.
